scripts.build: pnpm jetpack build plugins/jetpack plugins/boost js-packages/image-guide js-packages/critical-css-gen packages/plugin-deactivation packages/connection packages/jitm packages/my-jetpack packages/assets -v --no-pnpm-install --production
scripts.env:up: e2e-env start --activate-plugins jetpack-boost && pnpm run prepare:e2e
scripts.prepare:e2e: pnpm jetpack docker --type e2e --name t1 exec-silent -- chown -R www-data .htaccess wp-config.php wp-content
scripts.test:run: playwright install chromium && NODE_CONFIG_DIR='./config' ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=./output/allure-results NODE_PATH="$PWD/node_modules" playwright test
